notCovered.label: Dublin Bus, Go-Ahead Ireland, Bus Eireann

stations: 66 Luas stops across the Red and Green Lines (Connolly excluded - no real-time coverage in the NTA feed, see notCovered).
notes: Abbey Street is the Red Line hub; the Green Line interchange (Marlborough / O'Connell - GPO / O'Connell Upper) is a short walk away, not the same stop. Connolly (Red trunk, between George's Dock and Busaras) is filtered out of v1: the live NTA GTFS-RT v2 TripUpdates feed never carries a stopTimeUpdate for either of Connolly's two stop_ids (8220GA00423/8220GA00424), confirmed against multiple live polls during Dublin Sunday daytime service on 27 Sep 2026 - a real Red trip's own live stopTimeUpdate array skips straight from George's Dock to Busaras, omitting Connolly's slot entirely, while both neighbouring stops resolve correctly under their own stop_ids. Per docs/board-eligibility-rule.md, a station with no confirmable real-time service is filtered out of the app rather than shown with a silently empty board. The NTA live feed sometimes has no times for a stop for a few minutes; the app says so rather than showing a blank board.
